title: Replay Engineering and Policy: How to Define, Test and Interpret Deterministic Evidence
creator: Mark S. Weinstein
scope: Editorial synthesis of selected public records; eight is the selected exhibit count, not a count of all replay types or technologies.
audit_scope: Selected NIST water source files and ReleaseGate V4 suite rerun locally during v1.1 audit; other exhibit outcomes are source-reported. Project-local checks do not constitute unaffiliated certification.
limitations: Synthetic records do not establish real-world events.
Matching artifacts alone do not prove truth, historical execution, production readiness, compliance, or universal model determinism.

The Seven-Hash closure separately reports six computational boundaries and canonical repackaging of an unchanged historical payload; historical evidence archives were not hosted in the pinned registry record.
